; Smart Remarkable answer-here and agent selection-menu buttons.
; Exact target: Ferrari firmware 3.28.0.163.
; No credentials, file I/O, network I/O, native ABI calls, or Draw action.

VERSION 3.28.0.163

AFFECT /qml/common/SceneSelectionHandler.qml
    TRAVERSE Item#selectionRoot
        TRAVERSE SelectionContextualMenu#tools
            LOCATE AFTER ArkControls.ContextualMenu.Button#selectionDuplicate
            INSERT {
                ArkControls.ContextualMenu.Button {
                    id: smartRemarkableLlmButton
                    focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
                    type: tools.type
                    // One pending mode shared by both buttons prevents a rapid
                    // answer-here + agent double tap from creating two requests.
                    property string pendingMode: ""
                    iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/notebook_sparkles"
                    selected: pendingMode === "write_back"

                    Connections {
                        target: selectionRoot
                        function onVisibleChanged() {
                            smartRemarkableLlmButton.clearPendingMode()
                        }
                    }

                    // AppLoad's launcher API has no completion callback. If
                    // startup or pre-acceptance transport fails, keep the
                    // selection visible but release the UI guard after a
                    // bounded interval so the same lasso can be retried.
                    Timer {
                        id: smartRemarkablePendingReset
                        interval: 45000
                        repeat: false
                        onTriggered: smartRemarkableLlmButton.clearPendingMode()
                    }

                    // The worker sends this private chord only after the
                    // selected crop has been accepted by the remote bridge.
                    // Calling the stock close() path clears selection state
                    // without copying or deleting the underlying strokes.
                    Shortcut {
                        enabled: smartRemarkableLlmButton.pendingMode !== "" && selectionRoot.visible
                        sequence: "Ctrl+Alt+Shift+9"
                        onActivated: {
                            // Release the guard before close() changes visibility.
                            // This also disables the shortcut immediately, so a
                            // delayed chord cannot affect the next selection.
                            smartRemarkableLlmButton.clearPendingMode()
                            Qt.callLater(function() {
                                if (selectionRoot.visible) {
                                    selectionRoot.close()
                                }
                            })
                        }
                    }

                    function clearPendingMode() {
                        smartRemarkablePendingReset.stop()
                        pendingMode = ""
                    }

                    function requestMode(mode) {
                        if (pendingMode !== "") {
                            return
                        }
                        if (mode !== "write_back" &&
                                mode !== "whatsapp_only") {
                            return
                        }
                        pendingMode = mode
                        smartRemarkablePendingReset.restart()
                        if (!launch(mode)) {
                            clearPendingMode()
                        }
                    }

                    function launch(mode) {
                        // Resolve AppLoad only when tapped. Keeping the module
                        // out of the host file's static imports lets the stock
                        // selection component keep loading if AppLoad is ever
                        // absent or disabled.
                        var helper = null
                        try {
                            helper = Qt.createQmlObject(
                                'import QtQuick;\n' +
                                'import net.asivery.AppLoad 1.0;\n' +
                                'QtObject { function go(mode) { AppLoadLauncher.launchApplication("external::smart-remarkable", ["--selection-button=" + mode], ({}), false) } }',
                                selectionRoot,
                                "smart_remarkable_appload_launcher"
                            )
                            if (helper) {
                                helper.go(mode)
                                helper.destroy()
                                return true
                            } else {
                                return false
                            }
                        } catch (error) {
                            console.warn("Smart Remarkable launcher unavailable")
                            if (helper) {
                                helper.destroy()
                            }
                            return false
                        }
                    }

                    onClicked: requestMode("write_back")
                }

                ArkControls.ContextualMenu.Button {
                    id: smartRemarkableSendButton
                    focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
                    type: tools.type
                    iconSource: "qrc:/icons/sparkles.svg"
                    selected: smartRemarkableLlmButton.pendingMode === "whatsapp_only"

                    onClicked: smartRemarkableLlmButton.requestMode(
                        "whatsapp_only")
                }
            }
        END TRAVERSE
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
